public_body: Pioneer Valley Performing Arts Charter School Board Of Trustees
overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the board president's emails circulating minutes and an OML determination during the November 21, 2025 meeting contained no member opinion, and the AG credited the Board's account that the March 26 executive session email was not altered.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the board president's emails to members during the November 21, 2025 meeting, attaching October 21 minutes, were improper deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: In doing so, she did not violate the Open Meeting Law.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged that circulating an OML determination by email to members during the November 21, 2025 meeting was improper deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Likewise, distribution of the Open Meeting Law determination during the meeting did not violate the Open Meeting Law, just as it would have been permitted in advance of the meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged text was deleted from the executive session email attaching March 26 minutes, and that the deleted text may have been improper email deliberation.
allegations.key_passage: Absent sufficient evidence to the contrary, we credit a public body’s account of the facts.
